title: A Spectral Theory of Grokking: Weight Decay induces Feature Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.26679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In grokking an early fit to the training data separates from a much later improvement in generalization. During this delay, training can move from a fixed neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime to one in which task-relevant kernel eigendirections continue to evolve. We provide a quantitative theory for how this transition from lazy to rich learning can produce delayed generalization. For homogeneous networks trained with squared loss and $L_2$ weight decay, we show that a finite residual remains after memorization, with larger residual fractions in target components associated with smaller NTK eigenvalues. These residuals feed back into the dynamics of the NTK itself, and projecting the resulting dynamics onto task-relevant spectral directions yields a reduced system in which residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay. This system predicts that the grokking timescale is controlled by the product of learning rate and weight deca

translated_title: Grokking（顿悟）现象的谱理论：权重衰减诱导特征学习
translated_abstract: 在grokking现象中，对训练数据的早期拟合与更晚出现的泛化能力提升之间存在分离。在这一延迟期间，训练可以从固定的神经正切核（NTK）机制转变为任务相关的核特征方向持续演化的机制。我们为这种从“懒惰”学习到“丰富”学习的转变如何产生延迟泛化提供了定量理论。对于使用平方损失和L2权重衰减训练的齐次网络，我们证明在记忆化完成后仍会保留有限的残差，且与较小NTK特征值相关的目标分量中残差比例更大。这些残差反馈到NTK本身的动力学中，将由此产生的动力学投影到任务相关的谱方向上，得到一个简化的系统，其中残差驱动的核增长与权重衰减相互竞争。该系统预测grokking的时间尺度由学习率与权重衰减的乘积所控制。
tldr: 该论文提出了grokking现象的定量谱理论，证明记忆化后的残差通过反馈驱动NTK向任务相关谱方向演化，权重衰减与残差驱动的核增长相互竞争，从而实现从懒惰到丰富学习的转变并导致延迟泛化，且grokking时间尺度由学习率与权重衰减的乘积控制。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a quantitative spectral theory of grokking, showing that post-memorization residuals feed back to drive NTK evolution along task-relevant eigendirections, where residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay to produce delayed generalization, with the grokking timescale controlled by the product of learning rate and weight decay.
